description: Pre-flight check. PRICED: $0.001 in USDC on base via x402 -- no account, no API key, no invoice. Call without `payment` to receive the exact payment requirements, then call again with `payment` to be served. Is this endpoint alive, how long we have known it, what protocols it answers on, what it charges, and whether real money has ever reached it. Answered from our own probe record rather than the service's own claims. First 500 calls a day are free.
